trigger: Creator rejected Own Plate Theory and opened the fresh Instagram + competitor analysis.
analysis_takeaways_used: Contradiction hooks travel better than abstract love.
Carousels can work when first-line recognition is fast.
Every carousel needs three behavior receipts before the thesis.
Private language should become public formats.
Competitor simplicity should be borrowed without copying competitor identity.

rejected_current_lane.title: Own Plate Theory
rejected_current_lane.reason: Concept did not land; do not repair.

success_definition.audience_success: Viewer understands the situation in one second and can tag a partner with 'this is us'.
success_definition.creative_success: A staged daily-life scene with visible contradiction, at least three receipts, active Zuv role, and a joke-to-softness turn.
success_definition.brand_success: Hinglish emotional wit and intimate A Story of Two specificity without broad spouse-roast energy.
success_definition.production_success: Replacement shortlist only. No copy, visual room, prompt pack, or generation until creator selects a route.
